data.body: [P1] Once execution has selected `PENDING` or `RETRYING`, this synchronous call still waits indefinitely for the handler to leave its scopes. A blocked `finally` or plugin scope can therefore consume the remaining Lambda time and prevent the selected durable response from being returned. Bound this wait using `lambdaContext.getRemainingTimeInMillis()`, reserve time for finalization/output delivery, and ensure any abandoned handler cannot issue further checkpoints. Add a low-remaining-time test with blocked handler cleanup.
